title: Reuse acceptance evaluation and authority audit across a base-only carry with byte-identical changed paths
outcome: A changeset carried onto a newer master without touching its own changed paths keeps its review, acceptance evaluation and authority-audit evidence when it can be shown to be the same delivery, instead of commissioning a fresh evaluator, re-audit and review pair for every base move.
acceptance: A design, reviewed by Engram::Fable and a read-only Codex explorer, defines when a carry counts as base-only: the changed paths' blobs are byte-identical, the base delta is disjoint from them, and there is a stated rule for when the base delta could still change behaviour. It also defines what is reused (review round, acceptance evaluation, final-diff audit) and what is always rerun (the full gate on the exact committed tree, readiness)

The design names every governing text and core check it changes (acceptance-evaluation freshness, the review-changes audit rule, the standing approval's same-tree review condition) and says which of those changes widen agent authority; any widening goes to Greg with exact wording before coding
No evidence reuse is applied before Greg decides on the design
